wins.text: Record full-year net inflows of $698B including $342B in Q4; iShares set a new flows record with $527B in 2025, representing 12% organic asset and 13% organic base fee growth
Full-year revenue of $24B up 19% YoY; operating income of $9.6B up 18%; EPS of $48.09 a new record, up 10% YoY
Q4 organic base fee growth of 12% and full-year of 9%, with 6%+ growth in every quarter of 2025; base fees entering 2026 at ~$21B run rate, ~35% higher than 2024
Technology ACV grew 16% organically (31% including Preqin); technology services revenue up 24% YoY for both Q4 and full year
Record $5B returned to shareholders in 2025 via dividends and buybacks; Board approved 10% dividend increase for Q1 2026 and $1.8B in planned 2026 share repurchases

risks.text: Q4 as-adjusted operating margin of 45% was down 50 bps YoY; full-year margin of 44.1% down 40 bps, pressured by performance fees and related compensation from acquisitions
Institutional index net outflows of $119B in 2025, driven by redemptions from low-fee index equity strategies, creating a drag on overall net flows quality
HLEND Q4 redemptions of 4.1% were higher than recent quarters, driven by seasonal factors, media attention on private credit stress, profit-taking, and lower base rate expectations
Noncash mark-to-market loss of $106M in nonoperating results linked to minority investment in Circle; higher share count from HPS transaction diluted EPS growth to 10% despite strong revenue growth

Rising competition in insurance asset management, particularly in private high-grade; private credit default rates normalizing upward, with smaller borrowers ($0-$50M EBITDA) facing elevated stress at peak valuations

guidance_items.detail: Base fees entering 2026 at ~$21B run rate, ~13% higher than full-year 2025 and ~35% higher than 2024, driven by AUM at record $14T
Targeting 45% or greater adjusted operating margin; recurring FRE margin trending toward 50%+ over time, consistent with Investor Day targets
G&A expected to grow mid-single-digit % in 2026 after annualizing HPS and Preqin; headcount expected broadly flat in 2026
Share repurchases increased to $1.8B planned for 2026 vs. $1.6B in 2025; dividend per share raised 10% for Q1 2026
Private markets targeting $400B in gross fundraising through 2030; private markets to wealth series targeting at least $60B AUM by 2030; organic base fee growth expected to sustain 6-7%+ consistently

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Private credit headline risk and rising default rates in direct lending, particularly for smaller borrowers — management addressed but did not proactively disclose HLEND redemption rate of 4.1% or specific credit stress stratification
Competitive dynamics in insurance asset management and private high-grade — management acknowledged rising competition only when directly asked
Challenges in getting GIP wealth-channel product off the ground — raised by analyst; management did not address this specific concern in prepared remarks
